rules.rationale: Multiple N/O centers donate and accept water hydrogen bonds, the dominant favorable hydration term.
Intermediate heteroatom content (91 candidates) extends the polarity gradient with denser coverage than hetero_high.
Hydrocarbon-only solutes pay cavity-formation cost without compensating water hydrogen bonds.
Dense halogenation raises nonpolar surface area and weakens water affinity despite polarizability.

skills.hypothesis: Counter-hypothesis: downweight the low-confidence ESOL smiles_length role and order candidates by heteroatom polarity with a halogen hydrophobicity penalty. Fails if the score rewards compact nonpolar solutes.

rules.rationale: Polarity anchor retained because the hydrocarbon-versus-heteroatom contrast is mechanistically central to hydration.
Source ring role carried the highest transfer weight (0.76); acyclic solutes lack rigid hydrophobic ring surface.
Rotatable-bond role maps to branching (transfer weight 0.76); low branching limits buried nonpolar volume.
Signed source prior for smiles_mid is negative (-6.61); larger solutes add nonpolar solvation cost.

skills.hypothesis: Source-grounded transfer of the high-weight ring and branch roles plus the signed mid-length prior, now anchored by polarity. Fails if scaffold shape is irrelevant once heteroatom content is modeled.

state.lesson: On development seeds the polarity-led counter-hypothesis reached a markedly higher mean AUC (74.5) than the pure size/scaffold transfer (53.9), so polarity structure is the better semantic prior here; the size prior alone was the weakest source signal and should not drive ranking.
state.revision_summary: Refined the deployed polarity skill by removing the low-value short-length downweight and replacing it with a hetero_mid rule that gives denser, monotonic polarity coverage; slightly raised prior_scale, semantic_mass_start, and confidence while keeping fast decay to the target-only anchor. The second skill now anchors the source-grounded ring, branch, and signed mid-length roles on a polarity term rather than transferring size alone, so the source evidence is retested under a fairer configuration. Only catalog field-value pairs are used and no target outcomes are claimed.
